title: Textual shortcut/CLI parity, main-thread normal execution host, and concrete-app qualification

merge_window_decision.reason: R03 is the final implementation boundary: interface/shortcut parity, normal execution main-thread host, and real-app qualification. PRES-G2R remains a separate authoritative gate.

promises.text: One canonical shortcut registry owns Textual navigation/run/global bindings, legacy TUI derivation and UI-Core navigation shortcuts; collisions fail closed and Workers is present in the discoverable map.

devtool tui and the standalone Textual runtime accept all 11 canonical pages plus deliberate compatibility aliases; legacy build maps visibly to Runs, and interactive --width is explicitly reported as a --once/legacy-only override instead of being silently ignored.

--artifact is consumed by Textual and renderer-independent --once: it performs canonical overlay preflight, opens Overlays when appropriate, and surfaces structural/source/conflict/rebaseability truth without creating a TUI store; auto/textual --once does not silently fall back to legacy merely because the optional Textual package is unavailable.
Static zsh completion page choices are synchronized with the canonical page/alias contract.

Normal interactive invoke/build/test/lint/validate/run/package/CI/OCI execution now has a legal main-thread Textual host: parent owns Textual, managed child owns execution/RUN truth, Tasker live state and bounded child output feed the existing R01 execution app, and Ctrl+C delegates to the child process group.
Machine JSON, quiet, verbose/trace, redirected/non-TTY, CI, explicit plain/stdout-payload and managed-child paths bypass the Textual execution host; H02 remains the specialized artifact-apply host.
The concrete control center derives BINDINGS from the canonical registry and includes a real shortcut-table help modal and command palette.

Overlay apply and stale SSH worker recovery are concrete, confirmed controls that delegate to canonical Devtool CLI/domain authorities; generic artifact.apply, target.launch and worker cancel/resume remain explicitly unadvertised rather than preserved as fake metadata.

Broad real App.run_test/Pilot qualification covers every page shortcut, visible page changes, mouse navigation, help/palette, run selection/action failure, confirmed overlay apply and worker recovery dispatch, live logs, diagnostics, narrow Termux resize, Escape/back, Ctrl+C no-run behavior and clean quit; retained R02/R01/H02 real-app tests are rerun natively.
Prototype debug echo is absent and the reopened PRES-X04..X08/G1/G2 qualification record distinguishes concrete delivered controls from historical model-only promises.

deliberate_compatibility_transitions: Legacy page build -> runs with visible compatibility notice.
Interactive Textual ignores no dimensions silently: --width is explicitly documented/notified as a --once/legacy rendering override because live Textual follows actual terminal resize events.

Generic artifact.apply, target.launch and worker cancel/resume remain deliberately unadvertised because they do not have a safe concrete control-center contract. Overlay apply and worker recovery are adopted through canonical CLI/domain authorities instead of TUI-owned lifecycle logic.
still_open: PRES-G2R must audit the entire reopened R01/R02/R03/H01/H02 window plus historical X04..X08/G1/G2 claims against concrete runtime tests.
PRES-G3 final cross-surface presentation seal must explicitly dispose of legacy terminal/studio Rich Live HUD modes.

targeted_validation.construction: PRES-R03 contracts plus retained PRES R01/R02/H02/X08/G2 suites; concrete Textual tests are mandatory only on native/Textual validation host.
targeted_validation.native_required: ./devtoolw pres-r03 sets DEVTOOL_PRES_R03_REQUIRE_TEXTUAL=1 and executes R03 plus retained R01/R02/H02 concrete App.run_test/Pilot proofs.

next_major_scope: DIST finalization (DIST-R01 already qualified/applied; next DIST item DIST-G3 66/76)

native_retry_history.v2_correction: same PRES-R03 63/76 boundary; synchronize tests/ledger with concrete delegated controls, use parser-safe responsive CSS, and retain mandatory native real-App qualification
native_retry_history.v3_correction: same PRES-R03 63/76 boundary; correct the R03 real-App test to import ContentSwitcher from textual.widgets, matching the runtime and retained R02 qualification surface on the installed Textual API
v3_blockers: real Pilot overlay-apply click targeted a horizontally off-screen action without first scrolling it visible
control-center periodic refresh timer could fire during App.run_test/App.exit teardown and turn detached-DOM NoMatches into a runtime failure
native_retry_history.v4_correction: same PRES-R03 63/76 boundary; reuse the retained R02 scroll_visible Pilot pattern for overlay apply and the qualified H02 timer-stop/NoMatches/on_unmount lifecycle pattern for control-center refresh shutdown safety
v4_blockers: queued DataTable RowHighlighted callbacks could outlive the default Screen and call _render_details outside refresh_from_provider, bypassing the timer-only NoMatches guard
projection render helpers lacked one shared mounted/shutdown lifecycle barrier, allowing detached-DOM query_one calls such as #dashboard-detail during App.exit/run_test teardown
native_retry_history.v5_correction: same PRES-R03 63/76 boundary; add a projection-wide lifecycle barrier shared by timer callbacks and queued table/tree/input/navigation events, detach idempotently before quit/unmount, and make render helpers swallow teardown NoMatches while preserving canonical runtime truth
v5_blockers: Textual 8.2.8 enables its own built-in Ctrl+P command palette by default and injects a priority command_palette binding, preempting Devtool R03 show_command_palette
the native Pilot therefore opened Textual CommandPalette instead of the canonical Devtool CommandPaletteModal even though the Devtool binding and modal were both present
native_retry_history.v6_correction: same PRES-R03 63/76 boundary; disable Textual built-in command-palette injection on DevtoolTextualControlCenter so the canonical R03 Ctrl+P shortcut exclusively owns the concrete Devtool CommandPaletteModal, with static and native assertions for that ownership
